digest_rule: decision_sha256 = sha256 of json.dumps(decision-without-decision_sha256, sort_keys=True, separators=(',',':'), ensure_ascii=False) encoded UTF-8; head_sha256 = last decision's decision_sha256

decisions.asset: https://vote.sky.money/ (successor of vote.makerdao.com, the 2023 report's host)
decisions.basis: the program page names the vote asset and admits only Critical severity on it; the page's Last Updated marker is 19 September 2026 and Maximum Bounty is $10,000,000

decisions.system: Immunefi Vulnerability Severity Classification System v2.2
decisions.why_this_bullet: the finding's demonstrated consequence is arbitrary system command execution; the Critical row's file-read bullet enumerates /etc/shadow, database passwords and blockchain keys and excludes non-sensitive files, so the /etc/passwd read alone does not carry the level
decisions.why_not_smart_contracts_table: the affected asset is a website/application, and the v2.2 tables rank within their own asset class

decisions.quoted_clause: All other impacts that do not fall under this definition, but would be classified as Critical, and resulting in a theft of funds, will be rewarded USD 50 000 .

rejected_competing_clause.why: the $10,000 clause prices manipulation of polling votes or their display; the priced finding is command execution on the same host, so anchoring on the polling clause would price it 5x low

decisions.ladder_gap: the page prints no Critical website tier for an impact that is neither fund loss nor unauthorised minting; the $100,000 tier requires direct fund loss with zero user action, so a non-fund-loss Critical has no printed price and the 2023 payout is the only anchor

decisions.effect_on_price: none; KEV cannot raise priority here and VSCS v2.2 fixes the level largely on impact, not on exploitation likelihood

decisions.basis: PROVINCE.md:52 states live-target testing is refused
decisions.second_basis: the program's prohibited-activities list forbids testing mainnet or public testnet deployed code, and the published 2023 PoC route ran against a public testnet endpoint

decisions.why: the package re-prices a finding that was disclosed and paid in 2023; it was never a candidate for submission, no authorized testing exists behind it, and no non-author reviewer is attached to this wave-1 item

head_note: head_sha256 equals the final disposition decision's digest and is the value the manifest binds as expected_head_sha256
